up: Retrieve IC50 activity data for CHEMBL3183703 and its salt/derivative forms against the target NACHT, LRR and PYD domains-containing protein 3 (CHEMBL1741208). Use molecule_hierarchy to find the parent_molregno of CHEMBL3183703, then select all molregno values sharing that parent. Join with activities filtered by standard_type = 'IC50'. Join assays to target_dictionary where chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1741208'. Return md.chembl_id, md.pref_name, cs.canonical_smiles, a.standard_value, a.standard_units, a.standard_relation, a.assay_id, ass.description, ass.assay_type, docs.doi, docs.pubmed_id, docs.year, docs.title. Do not apply unit or relation filters. Include all matching rows.
sql:
WITH target_parent AS (
  SELECT mh.parent_molregno
  FROM molecule_dictionary md
  JOIN molecule_hierarchy mh ON md.molregno = mh.molregno
  WHERE md.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL3183703'
),
target_molecules AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT md.molregno
  FROM molecule_dictionary md
  JOIN molecule_hierarchy mh ON md.molregno = mh.molregno
  JOIN target_parent tp ON mh.parent_molregno = tp.parent_molregno
)
SELECT
  md.chembl_id,
  md.pref_name,
  cs.canonical_smiles,
  a.standard_value,
  a.standard_units,
  a.standard_relation,
  a.assay_id,
  ass.description,
  ass.assay_type,
  docs.doi,
  docs.pubmed_id,
  docs.year,
  docs.title
FROM target_molecules tm
JOIN activities a ON tm.molregno = a.molregno
JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON tm.molregno = md.molregno
LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON tm.molregno = cs.molregno
JOIN docs ON a.doc_id = docs.doc_id
WHERE
  a.standard_type = 'IC50'
  AND td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1741208';
